TO: Hosts at the community language exchange
SUBJECT: Welcoming people who changed tables

The board at the door shows which conversation tables have seats. When a visitor changes tables, update the seat totals [143] _____ so later arrivals can use the board. Do not write names there. The host’s private checklist, by contrast, keeps the names of visitors who still need the five-minute welcome.

A visitor who already had the welcome normally does not need it again. There is one exception: if the first welcome was given in a language the visitor did not understand, the next host should offer it in a language the visitor [144] _____. On Saturday, Hana moved from Table One to Table Three after hearing a welcome in a language she did not understand.

[145] _____ Before admitting the next visitor, check that the records for the table change are [146] _____.
